// why: checkJs + JSDoc types give the JS layer real type-checking with no build
step — editing a file still changes the window with no compile, which is
the argument for a script layer in the first place. gpui-kit.d.ts is
written by the runtime on launch (set_editor_files), so the declarations
strictNullChecks is off: a view assigns state in `init`, which TypeScript
cannot see as definite assignment, so every field would read as
possibly-undefined and every use would want a meaningless `?`.
